existing_proofs_preserved: Both public specifications remain credited. Six independently selected floating storage roles, fp32 compute casts, all 18 outer statements, source load/store order, zero padding and both RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT branches are represented. The general Real IO theorem covers termination, active gradients, optional forward output and frame; address commutation has empty numerical assumptions and arbitrary-backend complete-run equivalence. The concrete mixed-profile exact model checks nonzero pids, masked tail, both flags and later OUT-store alias overwrite.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Full typed materialization for six floating storage roles and both constexpr flags; general Real correctness and complete typed address-commutation equivalence, but not a general rounded typed value result.
Contiguous/view/split, optional allocation or caller buffers, grid/device launch and return-shape branches remain uncomposed.

dtype_review: Six independent storage choices for input/upstream/gradient/output are real modeled families, not only homogeneous fp32. They omit other original dtype admission/rejection paths; model flags and dispatch breadth are credited without claiming native compilation of all cases.
branch_review: Both kernel recomputation blocks, optional output masking and output order are already represented. Public Real IO includes the gated third store. Unclosed branches concern wrapper contiguous checks, optional dxy/out allocation, shapes/strides and tuple return, plus their relation to the kernel heuristic.

structural_gaps.finding: typed_real_correct proves the dtype-erased Real result; source_equivalence proves equality of original and address-commuted typed executions for arbitrary backend. Neither public statement gives the original rounded result for general typed inputs. NumericExecution gives one concrete mixed-profile exact-Real example with identity casts, including optional output alias order, not a general rounded-value contract.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: A case-specific numerical assumption cannot convert equality of two executions or a dtype-erased Real formula into the missing general typed execution/value theorem. Scalar sigmoid/cast conformance may be deferred once that result and its exact cases are represented.

def typedIO (input upstream gradient output : Storage) (v : Bool)
    (X Y DOUT OUT DX DY : RegionName) (sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B : Nat) (R : Bool) :
    Masked2DKernelIO₃ₓ₃ :=
  { swigluBackwardIO X Y DOUT OUT DX DY sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R with
    kernel := (typedKernel input upstream gradient output v X Y DOUT OUT DX DY
      sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R).eraseDType
    projection := typed_supported input upstream gradient output v X Y DOUT OUT DX DY
      sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R }

/-- Both full typed variants satisfy independent gradient and optional-forward
formulas from the original input windows, with successful execution and the
complete flat frame. Output regions are pairwise distinct; inputs may alias
outputs because all input loads precede every store. -/
specification typed_real_correct (input upstream gradient output : Storage) (v : Bool)
    (X Y DOUT OUT DX DY : RegionName) (sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B : Nat) (R : Bool)
    (hxy : DX ≠ DY) (hox : OUT ≠ DX) (hoy : OUT ≠ DY) :
    VeriTile.Spec.Real (typedIO input upstream gradient output v X Y DOUT OUT DX DY
      sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R ⊨
        fun _ _ xs ys ds => (fun j => Math.dx (xs j) (ys j) (ds j),
          fun j => Math.dy (xs j) (ds j), fun j => Math.forward (xs j) (ys j))) := by
  intro A hd hr hc p0 p1 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 xs ys ds s hp0 hp1 hu hx hy hz
  obtain ⟨t,he,hv1,hv2,hv3,hf⟩ := formula_correct X Y DOUT OUT DX DY
    sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R hxy hox hoy
    A hd hr hc p0 p1 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 xs ys ds s hp0 hp1 hu hx hy hz
  refine ⟨t,?_,hv1,hv2,hv3,hf⟩
  exact (typed_flat_exec A input upstream gradient output v X Y DOUT OUT DX DY
    sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R (A.flattenState s)).trans he

specification source_equivalence (input upstream gradient output : Storage)
    (X Y DOUT OUT DX DY : RegionName) (sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B : Nat) (R : Bool) :
    program input upstream gradient output Bool.false X Y DOUT OUT DX DY sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R ≡[assumptions]
      program input upstream gradient output Bool.true X Y DOUT OUT DX DY sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R := by

/-- Exact arithmetic witness for the operations used by these sources. This
backend is not an IEEE rounding model; casts preserve their exact input. -/
def model : Algebra (WithBot ℝ) where
  literal := fun _ _ r ↦ some r
  negInf := none
  binary := fun _ _ op a b ↦ match op with
    | .add => WithBot.realAdd a b
    | .sub => WithBot.realSub a b
    | .mul => WithBot.realMul a b
    | .div => WithBot.realDiv a b
    | .max => max a b
    | .pow => some 0
  unary := fun _ op a ↦ match op with
    | .sigmoid => WithBot.realSigmoid a
    | _ => some 0
  cast := fun _ _ _ x ↦ x
  fromNat := fun _ n ↦ some n
  fromInt := fun _ n ↦ some n
  fp32Bits := fun _ ↦ some 0
  fp32Load := id

/-- Both source variants execute both recomputation branches with actual loads,
fp32 casts, sigmoid, gradient stores and optional forward store. -/
def source_run (v R : Bool) :
    {t : State (WithBot ℝ) // run (engine model)
      (typedKernel .fp16 .fp64 .bf16 .f8e5 v "X" "Y" "DOUT" "OUT" "DX" "DY"
        4 5 6 7 8 9 3 2 R).surfaceBody initial = some t} := by
  cases v <;> cases R
  all_goals
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩

structural_gaps.finding: The materialized source independently selects input/upstream/gradient/output from six floating Storage constructors. The wrapper checks shape and stride but has no corresponding dtype restriction on xy, dout, supplied dxy or supplied out. Integer/bool and other source dtype admission/rejection cases are absent from this family.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The six floating families are credited but do not establish the complete source dtype domain. This review does not assume every unguarded dtype compiles successfully.

inductive Storage where
  | fp32 | fp16 | bf16 | fp64 | f8e4 | f8e5
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def typedKernel (input upstream gradient output : Storage) (v : Bool)
    (X Y DOUT OUT DX DY : RegionName) (sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B : Nat) (R : Bool) : ComputeKernel :=
  let body := (template v X Y DOUT OUT DX DY sx sy sd so sdx sdy N B R).surfaceBody
  ComputeKernel.mk [X,Y,DOUT] [DX,DY,OUT]
    (body.take 9 ++
      [typedLoad "X" "x" input B N, typedLoad "Y" "y" input B N,
       typedLoad "DOUT" "dout" upstream B N] ++
      (body.drop 12).take 3 ++
      [typedStore "DX" "dx" gradient B N, typedStore "DY" "dy" gradient B N,
       .ifThen (.constBool R) [recomputedValue B, typedStore "OUT" "out" output B N]])

structural_gaps.finding: Wrapper contiguous/reshape/chunk, optional dxy/out allocation versus supplied buffers, shape/stride guards, CUDA device context and complete two-dimensional launch are not composed with the per-program IO result. The wrapper returns either reshaped dxy or a tuple depending on recompute_output; X/Y and DX/DY are views into shared parent tensors, whose physical offsets must be related to the separate logical regions.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Kernel RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT true/false is already represented and proved; the missing work is wrapper branch/view/launch/result composition, not that constexpr branch itself. Legitimate per-block bounds and distinct logical output assumptions do not by themselves establish those host relations.

theorem swiglu_bwd_kernel_region_run
    (X Y DOUT OUT DX DY : RegionName)
    (stride_x_row stride_y_row stride_dout_row stride_out_row
      stride_dx_row stride_dy_row ncols BLOCK_N : Nat)
    (RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT : Bool)
    (hDXDY : DX ≠ DY) (hOUTDX : OUT ≠ DX) (hOUTDY : OUT ≠ DY)
    (s₀ : BlockState) (xs ys douts : Fin BLOCK_N → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N, s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
      s₀.readMem X (s₀.pids 0 * stride_x_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val)) = xs j)
    (hy : ∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N, s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
      s₀.readMem Y (s₀.pids 0 * stride_y_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val)) = ys j)
    (hdout : ∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N, s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
      s₀.readMem DOUT (s₀.pids 0 * stride_dout_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val)) = douts j) :
    ∃ s1, exec ((swiglu_bwd_kernel X Y DOUT OUT DX DY
          stride_x_row stride_y_row stride_dout_row stride_out_row
          stride_dx_row stride_dy_row ncols BLOCK_N
          RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT).toAlgKernel) s₀ = some s1
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N, s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
          s1.readMem DX (s₀.pids 0 * stride_dx_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val))
            = TiledActivation.swigluBwdA (douts j) (xs j) (ys j))
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N, s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
          s1.readMem DY (s₀.pids 0 * stride_dy_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val))
            = TiledActivation.swigluBwdB (douts j) (xs j))
      ∧ (∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N,
          RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT = Bool.true ∧ s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
          s1.readMem OUT (s₀.pids 0 * stride_out_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val))
            = TiledActivation.swiglu (xs j) (ys j))
      ∧ (∀ r o,
          (r ≠ DX ∨ ∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N, s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
            o ≠ s₀.pids 0 * stride_dx_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val)) →
          (r ≠ DY ∨ ∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N, s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →
            o ≠ s₀.pids 0 * stride_dy_row + (s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val)) →
          (r ≠ OUT ∨ ∀ j : Fin BLOCK_N,
            RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT = Bool.true ∧ s₀.pids 1 * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols →

def swigluBackwardIO (X Y DOUT OUT DX DY : RegionName)
    (stride_x_row stride_y_row stride_dout_row stride_out_row
      stride_dx_row stride_dy_row ncols BLOCK_N : Nat)
    (RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT : Bool) : Masked2DKernelIO₃ₓ₃ where
  kernel := swiglu_bwd_kernel X Y DOUT OUT DX DY
    stride_x_row stride_y_row stride_dout_row stride_out_row
    stride_dx_row stride_dy_row ncols BLOCK_N RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT
  in1 := X
  in2 := Y
  in3 := DOUT
  out1 := DX
  out2 := DY
  out3 := OUT
  B := BLOCK_N
  read1 := fun pid₀ pid₁ j => pid₀ * stride_x_row + (pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val)
  read2 := fun pid₀ pid₁ j => pid₀ * stride_y_row + (pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val)
  read3 := fun pid₀ pid₁ j => pid₀ * stride_dout_row + (pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val)
  write1 := fun pid₀ pid₁ j => pid₀ * stride_dx_row + (pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val)
  write2 := fun pid₀ pid₁ j => pid₀ * stride_dy_row + (pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val)
  write3 := fun pid₀ pid₁ j => pid₀ * stride_out_row + (pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val)
  mask := fun _ pid₁ j => pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols
  writeMask3 := fun _ pid₁ j =>
    RECOMPUTE_OUTPUT = Bool.true ∧ pid₁ * BLOCK_N + j.val < ncols


end VeriTile.Bench.TritonBenchG.SwigluBackward

numerical_boundary: Native sigmoid, ordered fp32 arithmetic and input/output casts are eligible only as exact numeric deferrals for a suitable execution/value theorem. Missing general typed result, storage-domain coverage and wrapper/grid correspondence are structural. No deferral is newly registered.
precondition_assessment: Per-program bounds and distinct logical output names remain legitimate premises. The review records absent wrapper view/grid composition rather than requiring arbitrary invalid aliases or unrestricted input shapes.
